versions.changelog:
UAIGC Avatar Engine — AI-powered avatar content engine for short-form social video.

- Enables script, image, and video generation for AI avatars on TikTok, Reels, Shorts, and Facebook.
- Provides a roster of customizable avatars, each with fixed persona, voice, and audience.
- Delivers structured, emotion-driven 16s video scripts with niche and brand content modes.
- Implements 10 configurable virality systems (emotion, micro-moment, tension, duo hooks, etc).
- Strong focus on specificity, channel differentiation, and payload discipline to maximize content effectiveness.
